scope: All 18 illustrated requests, with the later clarification to retain FAQ sections.

changes.implemented: Reduced oversized introductions and heading sizes, with a smaller editorial scale for blog and project pages. Poppins is preserved and now loads locally.
Placed existing contextual links inside a consistent planning-resource panel.
Added a readable heading width, introduction spacing and balanced project-card padding.
Removed only the “: questions” heading suffix. All FAQ sections and answers remain, following the user’s clarification.
Kept both original images; used bounded, proportional desktop/mobile previews and consistently spaced captions.
Applied theme-aware gradients and corrected the large headings inside project notes. Project descriptions remain unchanged.
Moved icons above the text and gave descriptions the full card width.
Stacked the icon and copy, removed the narrow side divider and balanced padding.
Changed “Get Quote” to “Discuss your project” in desktop and mobile navigation.
Placed “All insights” beneath the section heading and kept its label on one line. Also corrected narrow-screen insight-card overflow.
Added a continuous horizontal loop with equal-width duplicated sets, a pause control and a static, swipeable reduced-motion alternative. The original tablet/desktop carousel remains.
Reduced card width and padding, removed the edge fade and added a mobile pause/resume control.
Stacked icons above descriptions so content is no longer squeezed into a narrow text column.
Reduced the heading size and removed the forced mobile line break while preserving readable word spacing.
Improved heading hierarchy, paragraphs, lists, technology cards and challenge spacing; used a single-column mobile layout.
Removed the repeated “service / Cubusify” labels and equivalent redundant service/team/work hero tags.
Replaced the old page-specific trails with one accessible themed component, including Home, linked ancestors and the current page.
Applied cobalt/cyan gradients to heading text, with light variants on dark surfaces and a forced-colors fallback.

validation.score: 10 / 10 local implementation checklist on all 84 routes
validation.limits: Local checks do not measure keyword demand, rankings, backlinks or actual organic traffic. Screenshots were captured in desktop Chrome with fixed-width iframe viewports, not physical devices. Mobile-only layout fixes use max-width:600px; global typography and gradients intentionally apply at every width.
